workspace_food_entries_nutrition.name: workspace_food_entries_nutrition
workspace_food_entries_nutrition.value: "workspace_food_entries"."calories" between 0 and 10000 and "workspace_food_entries"."protein" between 0 and 1500 and "workspace_food_entries"."carbs" between 0 and 2500 and "workspace_food_entries"."fat" between 0 and 1500

workspace_recipes_nutrition.name: workspace_recipes_nutrition
workspace_recipes_nutrition.value: "workspace_recipes"."calories" between 0 and 10000 and "workspace_recipes"."protein" between 0 and 1500 and "workspace_recipes"."carbs" between 0 and 2500 and "workspace_recipes"."fat" between 0 and 1500

workspace_workout_exercises_target.name: workspace_workout_exercises_target
workspace_workout_exercises_target.value: "workspace_workout_exercises"."target_sets" between 1 and 20 and "workspace_workout_exercises"."rep_min" between 1 and 200 and "workspace_workout_exercises"."rep_max" between "workspace_workout_exercises"."rep_min" and 200 and "workspace_workout_exercises"."rest_seconds" between 0 and 900

workspace_workout_exercises_load.name: workspace_workout_exercises_load
workspace_workout_exercises_load.value: "workspace_workout_exercises"."load_type" in ('total', 'per_hand', 'bodyweight', 'assistance') and ("workspace_workout_exercises"."target_weight" is null) = ("workspace_workout_exercises"."target_unit" is null) and ("workspace_workout_exercises"."target_unit" is null or "workspace_workout_exercises"."target_unit" in ('lb', 'kg'))

workspace_workout_sets_values.name: workspace_workout_sets_values
workspace_workout_sets_values.value: ("workspace_workout_sets"."weight" is null or "workspace_workout_sets"."weight" between 0 and 2000) and ("workspace_workout_sets"."reps" is null or "workspace_workout_sets"."reps" between 0 and 500) and ("workspace_workout_sets"."rir" is null or "workspace_workout_sets"."rir" between 0 and 10)

workspace_workout_sets_completed.name: workspace_workout_sets_completed
workspace_workout_sets_completed.value: not "workspace_workout_sets"."completed" or ("workspace_workout_sets"."reps" is not null and "workspace_workout_sets"."reps" >= 1)
